subject: english
stem:
Mia once stayed silent during group reports. She began practicing one short part with a friend. Last week, she clearly presented the opening by herself.
What is the text mainly about?
options: Every quiet person should give long talks
Practice helped Mia become more confident speaking

optionRationales.reason: Mia has one friend：朋友只是練習方式的細節。
Every quiet person should give long talks：原文只描述 Mia 且部分很短。
Mia stopped joining reports：結尾明說她完成 opening。
Practice helped Mia become more confident speaking：首尾從沉默到獨自報告，中段練習解釋轉變。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「開頭設定的問題或主題與結尾給出的結果互相呼應」可推出 Practice helped Mia become more confident speaking；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Practice helped Mia become more confident speaking 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
